prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Last summer when I was in Chengdu, I remember chatting with friends about what was playing in town, just because we kept passing movie posters.
And on a totally different trip, I was in Suzhou in 2025 and we kept comparing places to stay around the old streets, mostly just swapping notes.
That Chengdu night was funny—Sophia Garcia had already arranged four seats for The Wandering Earth 3, so we just tagged along.
She’d picked Pacific Cinema and the showtime was 19:00, so we basically planned dinner around that and didn’t think too hard.
In Suzhou, Li Na had already set the stay up at Home Inn Pingjiang—check-in was 2025-04-08 for 3 nights—so we just followed her itinerary.
